name: Review Heatmap
description: Adds an interactive calendar review heatmap, streaks, and 90-day due forecast to the deck browser — modeled after Glutanimate's Review Heatmap.
author: Cardly
configHelp:
Configure Review Heatmap appearance and behavior.

• viewMode: "year" | "continuous"
• colorScheme: "ice" | "olive" | "flame" | "lavender"
• showForecast: true | false
• weekStartsOn: "monday" | "sunday"
• dailyTarget: number (e.g. 20)
• position: "below" | "above"
